title: Empty Library Buildings Hid 739 Million Digital Checkouts
hook: Libraries looked emptier while digital checkouts reached 739 million.
closing: Library readers did not vanish; borrowing moved wherever readers carry a phone.
question: How do you borrow library books?

segments.say: Library visits fell to 671 million. The building got quieter, but demand for books did not disappear.
Library digital checkouts climbed to 739 million. Borrowing simply moved into an app.
